categories.main_business_segments: The company operates three core business segments: Digital Medical (数字医疗) providing pathology digitization, remote diagnosis services, and cell DNA analysis systems; Smart Optics (智慧光学) manufacturing optical microscopes, digital microscopes, and imaging systems; and Smart Electrical (智能电气) producing epoxy insulation components for medium, high, and ultra-high voltage applications. These segments serve healthcare, education, research, and power transmission industries respectively.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs integrated innovation combining multiple technologies: digital pathology scanning and AI-assisted diagnosis using deep learning algorithms; precision optical design and manufacturing for microscopy systems with advanced imaging capabilities; and specialized epoxy resin formulation with proprietary molding and curing processes for electrical insulation components. The company holds 88 invention patents, 77 utility patents, and 100 software copyrights in optics; 14 invention patents and 10 utility patents in digital medical; and 9 invention patents and 96 utility patents in electrical components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves diverse customer bases: healthcare institutions and independent medical laboratories for digital pathology services; educational institutions (primary, secondary, and higher education) and research organizations for microscopy products; and power transmission equipment manufacturers including ABB, Schneider Electric, Siemens, and Siyuan Electric for electrical components. Geographic markets span 109 countries and regions with significant presence in Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with major presence in mainland China, Hong Kong, Europe (Germany, Spain), North America (USA, Canada), and Asia-Pacific regions. Domestic operations are concentrated in Xiamen (headquarters), with additional facilities in Chengdu, Guiyang, Shenyang, and other cities. International operations are managed through subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Germany, Spain, USA, and Canada. In 2023, domestic market revenue was 53.63% while overseas markets (including Hong Kong and Taiwan) accounted for 46.37% of total revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple supply chain positions: in digital medical, it functions as both a service provider (remote diagnosis) and equipment manufacturer; in smart optics, it is primarily a manufacturer and system integrator; in smart electrical, it operates as a specialized component manufacturer serving downstream equipment manufacturers. The company controls key aspects of production from raw material sourcing through final product delivery, with some outsourcing of non-core manufacturing processes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: advancing digital pathology through AI-assisted diagnosis systems, cloud platform optimization, and nationwide quality control network expansion; expanding smart optics into industrial inspection, semiconductor testing, and scientific research applications while maintaining education market leadership; and transitioning smart electrical toward intelligent, digitalized, and green solutions including smart grid components and new energy applications. R&D investment in 2023 was 61.49 million yuan (4.50% of revenue), focusing on product innovation, material science, and software development.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through multiple models: product sales of microscopes, electrical components, and medical equipment; service revenues from remote pathology diagnosis and quality control services; licensing and software services; and consumables/reagents sales. In 2023, direct sales accounted for 86.44% of revenue while distribution channels represented 13.56%. The company employs both direct sales to major customers and distributor networks for market penetration.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In digital medical, the company competes with other independent medical laboratories and diagnostic service providers. In smart optics, competitors include international microscope manufacturers like Zeiss and Leica, though the company emphasizes domestic market leadership and cost advantages. In smart electrical, the company is positioned as an industry leader ('hidden champion') in epoxy insulation components, competing primarily with other domestic manufacturers while serving major multinational equipment makers. The company emphasizes technological differentiation, brand recognition, and customer relationships as competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of 1.365 billion yuan (down 23.89% from 2022's 1.794 billion yuan) and net profit attributable to shareholders of 168.78 million yuan (down 35.37% from 261.14 million yuan). The decline was primarily due to policy changes in medical services and market adjustments. Total assets reached 2.293 billion yuan with shareholder equity of 1.688 billion yuan. Operating cash flow improved to 310.21 million yuan (up 29.53% year-over-year), indicating solid operational performance despite revenue challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through: comprehensive digital pathology solutions combining hardware, software, and cloud services with AI capabilities; advanced optical technology enabling high-resolution, automated microscopy systems with intelligent analysis; and specialized epoxy insulation components meeting stringent performance requirements for power transmission. Key differentiators include 30+ years of brand heritage in optics, proprietary AI algorithms for pathology diagnosis, extensive patent portfolio, global distribution network, and integrated solutions approach combining hardware, software, and services to address customer pain points in healthcare, education, and industrial sectors.
